notes.title: Bride for the Princess Full Release!
notes.notes:
Our latest Visual Novel has left Early Access and is now a full release!

It'll have a special launch discount of -15% off the full price. We hope that you'll enjoy playing it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1144550/Bride_for_the_Princess/

We also have released Digital Artbook

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1429860

You may also get them together on a Special Edition.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16263

notes.title: Version 1.35
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11001779/7371b85b2b61d2115fa2085b086b4d0fa886eda4.png

Balancing

Lowered the percentile damage of "Drugged" state in Hardcore mode to 2% (Was 5%)
Cloak of Immunity now protects against "Drugged" state
Deadly Doves MP now costs 10 mana to use (was 8)
Lightning now costs 8 mana to use (was 6)
Lowered the Scaling of Lightning to 13 (was 15)
Increased scaling of Thunder Storm to 13 (was 12)
Increased base damage of Thunder Storm to 13 (was 10)
Thunder Storm now costs 12 mana to use
Lowered cast time of Thunder Storm
Increased cast time of lightning
Increased base damage of Dark Wave to 10 (was 2)
Increased base damage of White to 7 (was 2)
Increased base damage of Flare to 5 (was 2)
Increased Lady of Ice AGI to 30 (was 25)
Increased scaling of Drain to 2 (was 0.1)
Lowered base dmage of Drain to 20 (was 30)
Final Boss now only takes 85% of lightning damage (was 100%)
Increased Final Boss AGI to 35 (was 32)
Man-Eater of Depth now takes 150% thunder damage in hardcore mode (was 160%)
Absolute Zero now does 300 damage per Icicle landed (was 500)
Nuke now does 1800 damage (was 4500)
Pearl now does 1500 damage (was 3200)
Pearl now no longer does True Damage
Ungolia can now do "Earth Crash" move
Nuke now no longer does True Damage
God of Destruction summon now does 2000 damage (was 2100)
Abyss now only uses Summon of God Destruction when at 85% hp or under
Increased base damage of Meteor Shower to 15 per Meteor landed (was 13)
Ungolia is now immune to stuns and sleeps in Hardcore mode
Increased accuracy of Alice to 100% (was 98%)
Worms now cost money (3 gold) 
Energizers now restore 300 mana
Healthbrews now restore 500 health
Removed Orbital Strike
Removed reduntant dummy skill from Fire Lizard
Fire Lizards now use Fire instead of Flare
Fire Lizards now use Fire instead of Flare in hardcore mode
Final Boss now uses Fire instead of Flare
Final Boss now uses Fire instead of Flare in hardcore mode
Final Boss in hardcore mode no longer does Final Fisting
Cure All now has base heal of 1250 (was 250)

Bugfix

The fog graphic could fly off screen in the mine transport and the Ice hell entrance rooms, this has been fixed.
If using teleport in Trixie's trial, the light overlay would teleport with you causing graphical error, this has been fixed
Under certain, special conditions, it was possible to die and then loading a save, you'd die again. This has now been fixed.
Healthbrews potentially healed different ammount depending if used in or out of combat, this inconsistency has been fixed
Game had to be closed twice in some cases to truly quit the game, this has now been fixed
Two secret chests could be opened in both hardcore and softcore in Lava pit, this has been fixed

Gameplay

Made the save spots in Ice Hell red for better clarity
Added chest with Energizer at the Mine level
Added chest with Power Shroom at the Mine level on hardcore
Added "True Sword of Kings" weapon that can be obtained in Hardcore mode
New bait "Rock Shrimp" added
New fish "Red Fish" added, which can be turned into health brews
New optional boss "Mimic" added, defeating this difficult boss earns you Mana Juice that permanently increases Max Mana by 200
Game now literally warns you about going past entrance of Ice Cave without equiping Sword of Kings
You can now move rocks and moving blocks by simply walking into them
Added a rock in the fishing pond in Witch's Cabin
Game now literally prevents you from leaving Sultry Succubus after talking to King if you don't have the Poison Soup, because some people skip dialogue too much.  If you have already done the quest in a previous save, talk to the bartender again and you'll be able to proceed.
Added a check to allow gallery pictures to go above the threshold, to allow the chests to function correctly with older saves

Graphical

Added light effects to Save Points in Ice Hell
Added icon for Spirit Arrow, Lightning and Thunder Storm
Improved the visual animation of pushing rocks and moving blocks
Added message at the end to hint that the game's not stuck and wants you to move into the Hardcore mode
Changed the graphic for puzzle reset switch in Ice Cave to make it stand out much, much more

notes.title: 1.1 update
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11001779/79f7aa2ea2d0bc7a8e1bf754098222a3c3dbaa3c.png

Audio

This chant may have interfered a bit with the neat song in Trixie scene

SFX chant in Trixie's room now fades out when the music begins playing

Bugfix

Straight up bugs that are now squashed

Leaving Ice Cave during sofcore mode could leave the snow effect on, this has been fixed.
Fixed issue where gallery didn't count certain pics properly towards the achievement
Game turned tutorials off by default regardless of what was chosen, this has been fixed.
You were able to open same secret chest in softcore and hardcore modes, this has been fixed

 
See bellow for a reason
Reverted the safeguards from Final Pancake

Gameplay

A feature that had been requested makes return

Enabled option to skip the intro

Since Day 1 Final Pancake has had problems that were massive, game breaking ones. It's about time we accept that some moves are just too awesome to be portrayed within videogames and move on.

Removed Final Pancake from the game, instead Trixie now teaches "Final Fisting"
If you were taught Final Pancake in earlier version, passing through Gates of Heaven teaches you Final Fisting

Balancing

I noticed that after the previous update, the enemies didn't do their special moves enough, this rectifies that and other minor balance issues

Adjusted the likelihood of Ungolia's Bone Crush
Adjusted the likelihood of Lady of Ice's Absolute Zero and tied it to her needing to be 85% hp or lower for it to trigger
Adjusted the likelihood of Jenna's Orbital Strike and tied it to her needing to be 50% hp or lower for it to trigger
Adjusted the likelihood of Mongo's Mongo Crush and tied it to him needing to be 65% hp or lower for it to trigger
Lowered Jenna's agility to 65 (was 69)
Adjusted the likelihood of Abyss Absolute Zero and tied it to him needing to be 85% or lower for it to happen

notes.title: Version 1.08
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11001779/59146c3d1d1fdff1acbe3e7cd5a01fbbecae978c.png

Balancing

Lady of Ice now uses Absolute Zero on certain turn intervals instead of it being tied to her HP.
Jenna uses Orbital Strike on certain turn intervals instead of it being tied to her HP.
Jenna prioritizes poisoning her enemy instead of healing herself on hardcore mode.
Ungolia now uses Bone Crush on certain turn intervals instead of it being tied to her HP.
Mongo now uses Mongo Crush on certain turn intervals instead of it being tied to his HP.
Abyss now uses Absolute Zero on certain turn intervals instead of it being tied to his HP.
Increased Tongue of Flames MP cost to 5 (was 4).
Reduced the likelihood that the Demon guard can heal himself.
Reduced the likelihood that Fire Lizards may cast Flare.
Reduced the likelihood that Shrooms may poison you in Hardcore mode.
Mongo's attack is now 113 (was 123).

Gameplay

Lucky Necklace now also doubles EXP gain rate. 

New Item

Sergei now gives "Book of Wonders" in hardcore mode, instead of Power Shroom. Book of Wonders cuts all mana cost by 75% and increases Wisdom by 10.

Vocabulary

Magical Attack is now called Wisdom or WIS for short.
Magical Defense is now called Spirit or SPI for short.
Hit rate is now called Accuracy.

notes.title: Version 1.07
notes.notes:
Bug fix

The random error with Final Pancake crashing the game has been fixed.
In some rare cases the mana did not work as intended, this bugfix should resolve every issue with mana.
The skill/item hud when in combat did not cover big enough area, this has been fixed.
Lava transport background sometimes scrolled with the player's movement, this has been fixed.
"Evil Transport" overlay sometimes on certain conditions scrolled with the player's movement when it shouldn't have, this has been fixed.
Talking to Glamour again at "Evil Transport" would leave her music playing after the discussion had ended, this has been fixed.

Dialogue

Changed cure's description to explain it works on the user.

Gameplay

Added tutorial for fishing.
Added steel bridges to Lava Pit in softcore mode for safe passages. Hardcore mode does not have safe passages. This also brings much needed diversity between Hardcore and Softcore modes in the Lava Pit.

Visual changes

Changed the color of the save points in the Ice Hell, to better stand out from the blue ice background.

notes.title: Version 1.06
notes.notes:
Bug fix

Liliam's dialogue would partially disappear when you talk to her about the King's plan, this has now been fixed.
The Spell book would not lower the mana consumption in battles and only in menus, this has been fixed.

Gameplay

Increased Tongue of Flames MP cost to 4 (was 3)
Increase Lightning's MP cost to 6 (was 5)
Increased Suplex's MP cost to 2(was 1)

Intro

Based on videos seen, the text crawl was made slower, which can be sped up when needed.
Added an option to skip the intro.

Tutorial

Explained how Hell Casket works when you first try it out.

Visual

Made all resolution colors white to avoid confusion in what is actually active.

notes.title: Version 1.04
notes.notes:
Balancing 

Made Fire Lizards immune to fire.
Made Lady of Ice sometimes freeze Alice when casting an ice spell.
Decreased the hitbox size of Hoglobyte to avoid him dying too easily against Tongue of Flames.
Decreased the damage rate of Fire damage done to Hoglobyte to 100%. (Was 150%)

Bug fixes

Bella would sometimes cause the player to go into a loop when given food, this has been fixed.

Gameplay

Added Fire Lizards to regular game.
Removed save point from the fourth level.
Saving point has to be earned in Gates of Heaven.




Lore

Glamour now warns Alice that she can't help her in the fourth level and that she shouldn't venture forward until she's ready.


<SPOILERS END HERE!!!

Visual 

Hoglobyte now has a death zoom animation.
Guard demon now has a death zoom animation.

notes.title: Version 1.02 hotfix
notes.notes:
It came to my attention that there was a bug, so I released this hotfix to patch it up.

Audio

Made the groan from Marouka altar more noticeable.

Bug fixes

Small text garble when trying to free princess with a key droppped from a guard has been fixed.
Guard demon going into loop in certain conditions has been fixed.
Sometimes guard demon refused to move away despite that they should have, this has been fixed.
You could walk on a spot in jail that shouldn't have been passable; this has been fixed.

Credits

Included proper credits for Jenna's combat voice actress.
Included proper credits for some of the UI elements that hadn't been credited before.

Gameplay

Made the Salamander no longer wander around and instead guard one spot in the flooded room to prevent him from wandering around.
Made the green dress demoness repeat her first lines of dialogue in Hardcore mode like the others.

Visual

Added few torches near the Marouka altar.
Added hover alerts over various events and people to make them more noticeable and to add visual feedback to the players.
